name: SWI/SNF related BAF chromatin remodeling complex subunit C2

function.text: SMARCC2 encodes SWI/SNF complex subunit SMARCC2. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and ATP-dependent chromatin remodeler activity. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Coffin-Siris syndrome (autosomal dominant); Coffin-Siris syndrome 8 (autosomal dominant).
